newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's M6 seeks 15 percent audience share.
newsitem.headline: France's M6 seeks 15 percent audience share.

text.p: French terrestrial television channel M6 aims to achieve a 15 percent audience share over the next five years, chairman Jean Drucker said in an interview with La Tribune on Thursday.
M6 currently has a 12.5 percent share of the French TV audience.

"We are aiming at a 15 percent audience share, and 20 percent among those aged under 50, in the next five years. This will be done while maintaining M6's current format and, of course, its profitability," he said.
He said he had no estimates of what impact the broadcasting of national advertising during local programmes had on M6's advertising revenue.
He put the cost of developing Television par Satellite (TPS, one of two French digital satellite television offerings) at 16.7 million francs. M6 has 20 percent of TPS.
The venture will lop a little over 100 million francs off M6's 1997 net profit, Drucker said.
